0.description: Marks of Ascension from Fresh Character trials have been increased by 30%.

Fixed a bug where creature spells without a spell damage classification: Melee, Ranged, Magic would not scale based on scaling auras like flex raid modifiers, manastorm level, etc. This would cause spells to both deal TOO much damage when doing a solo manastorm or not as much as intended like in a 25 man raid. This was a small set of 100 or so spells total in the game.

1.description: Fixed a bug where Fiery Payback Capstone would only work for specific fire mage spells. Now it works according to the tooltip description: All direct fire spells. (This does not include fire ranged and melee abilities)
[Elune] [Pending Update] Fixed a bug causing Spartan Kick to show up in the general spellbook tab, instead of the Rogue spellbook tab.
[Elune] [Pending Update] Fixed a bug where the Feral Instinct Capstone could fail to reduce the cooldown of Goldrinn's Fury.
[Elune] [Pending Update] Fixed a bug where Challenging Howl, the Dark Apotheosis taunt. Did not always force aggro on you.
[Elune] [Pending Update] Fixed a bug causing Chaos Meteor to not always benefit from Corrupted Maelstrom Weapon.
[Elune] [Pending Update] Fixed a bug with Chaos Meteor. It should now properly benefit from Felstorm.
[Elune] [Pending Update] Fixed a bug preventing Arcanist's Meteors from benefitting from the first stack of Flame On!
[Elune] [Pending Update] Fixed a bug causing Battle Charge to put other gapcloser abilities on a 16 sec cooldown instead of the stated 8 sec cooldown.
[Elune] [Pending Update] Fixed a bug making Favor of the Spirits show up as a level 60 talent instead of a level 30 talent.
[Elune] [Pending Update] Fixed a bug preventing Festering Strike from triggering additional Shadow damage from Corrupted Bear Form.
[Elune] [Pending Update] Fixed a bug preventing Savage Synergy form affecting Bloodthirst while in Worgen Form and Serpent Form.
[Elune] [Pending Update] Fixed a bug preventing Wind Slam from triggering with all Judgements except for Judgement of Command.

[Elune] [Pending Update] Fixed a bug with Incarnation items where they were bypassing the global-cooldown and mana cost of a Shapeshift. All Incarnations now have a 5 second cast time and consume properly.
[Elune] [Pending Update] Fixed a bug where Lunar Aspiration did not trigger Pack Tactics and Sinister Transfusion.
[Elune] [Pending Update] Fixed a bug where Solar Strike did not trigger Apprentice of Shadows at 3 stacks, turning it into Master of Shadows.
[Elune] [Pending Update] Fixed a bug causing your character to temporarily stop if you used Vanish while knowing Darting Shadows.
[Elune] [Pending Update] Victory Rush, Thunder Clap and Whirlwind will now start auto-attacks for your character if you start a fight with them.
[Elune] [Pending Update] Fixed a bug where Waxing Moon did not stack on targets affected by Lunar Aspiration and Sunfire.
[Elune] [Pending Update] Fixed the tooltip of Hateful Strike to clarify that direct damaging Warrior abilities have a chance to grant Hate.
[Elune] [Pending Update] Fixed a bug where Astral Mind would not trigger when hitting 10 stacks.
[Elune] [Pending Update] Fixed a bug where Cauterizing Flames would not trigger Impeccable Timing when cast on friendly targets.
[Elune] [Pending Update] Fixed a bug where Cat Forms was not granting baseline flat amount of attack power, they will now grant 1 per player level + 25% of your agility.
[Elune] Fixed a bug where Victory Rush hits not enabled by Last Stand failed to trigger the cooldown reduction of Victorious Stand.
[Pending Restart] Updated the tooltip of the Holy Specialization Capstone to clarify that the Holy Critical Strike Chance increase affects the next Holy spell-cast.
[Pending Restart][Elune] Fixed a bug with Blessed by the Moon and Blessed by the Sun where they would not apply currently known Moonfire / Insect Swarm transforms.

5.description: [Pending restart & cache clear] Fixed an issue where Ribsplitter had lower DPS than intended. It is now the same as other comparable One-Handed weapons.

0.description: Fixed a bug where Shadow Born was increasing Shadowburn damage by more than intended and stated on the tooltip. It was increasing damage by 35% in PvE and PvP, instead of the intended 25% in PvE and 10% in PvP.
Fixed a bug where Wave of Despair did not have its PvP mod applied properly. This PvP mod is 20% less damage versus players.
Fixed a bug where Astral Fusion was consuming on hit rather than on cast.
[Elune] You now take 5% less damage versus players.

1.description: [Pending Restart] [Elune] Flesh Hook will now pull targets in front of you, instead of right on your position (to simplify attacking afterwards). Also fixed a bug where you did not have to face your target while using it.
[Pending Restart] Fixed a bug where Flourish was not affecting the Heal over Time portion of Growing Earth.

[Pending Restart] [Elune] Fixed a bug where Frenzied growths 100% bonus healing to Wild Growth was being reduced to 50% while the Grove Ranger talent was learned. (It now just grants the full 100% healing even while Grove Ranger talent is learned.)
[Elune] Fixed a bug where Thrill of the Hunt did not reduce the cooldown of Focused Burst.

4.description: [Pending Restart] [Divine Circle] Is now also affected by Greater Heal.

0.description: [Pending Patch] [Elune] Fixed a bug where the Savage Wounds skill card was incorrectly named.

1.description: [Pending Restart] [Elune] Fixed a bug where Atal'ai Totem was not dealing the same damage as Searing Totem. It now has correct scaling and will scale with the same modifiers as Searing Totem.
[Pending Restart] [Elune] Fixed a bug where the Master Tactician talent could not trigger from Explosive Shot.
[Pending Restart] [Elune] Fixed a bug where Prayer of Preservation was not correctly consuming the Serendipity buff.
[Pending Restart] [Elune] Fixed a bug where Light of Dawn could not trigger the self heal portion of the Touched by the Light talent.
[Pending Restart] [Elune]  Fixed a bug where Faithful Light talent could not trigger from Cauterizing Fire healing.

[Pending Restart] [Elune] Fixed the tooltip of Direct Command to correctly state: Increases the damage of your Seal of Command by 20% but it now only hits 1 additional target. (It no longer removes the AoE portion of Seal of Command entirely.)
[Pending Restart] Fixed a bug where Seed of Corruption would consume Backlash even though it was not benefitting from its effects.
[Pending Restart] [Elune] Fixed a bug where Arrows of Frost had too large of a range and did not abide by line of sight rules. It now has 40 yard range and correctly abides by line of sight rules.
[Pending Restart] [Elune] Fixed a bug where Arrows of Fire had too large of a range and did not abide by line of sight rules. It now has 40 yard range and correctly abides by line of sight rules.
[Pending Restart][Elune]Fixed a bug where Deranged Druid did not cast Cat form abilities while in Serpent or Worgen Form.
[Pending Restart][Elune]Fixed a bug where mechanics applying corruption would not apply highest known rank of Shadow Arrow damage over time effect.

7.description: [Pending Restart] Fixed a bug where Concentrated Power Word: Shield and Concentrated Rejuvenation were not reducing the mana cost shown on their respective ability tooltips.
[Pending Restart] [Area-52] [Champion of Justice] Fixed a bug where Righteous Justice stance was scaling from Righteous Fury talents.
[Pending Restart] [Area-52] [Champion of Justice] Fixed a bug where healing an ally with Crusaders Justice did not grant them Crusaders Beacon.
[Pending Restart] [Area-52] [Champion of Justice] Fixed a bug where Righteous Justice did not grant 20% of your Attack Power to Healing Power.
[Pending Restart] [Area-52] [Champion of Justice] Fixed an issue where Righteous Justice did not grant 20% Attack Power to Healing Power

0.description: [Pending Restart] - Fixed an issue where 212 golden skill cards had a higher than intended gold price on the vendor. Examples are titanic mutilate that had a 10,000 gold cost instead of the intended 1,250.

1.description: [Pending Restart] [Elune] Fixed a bug where Contagious was not causing your periodic Disease damage to deal 10% more damage whilst you were within 10 yards of an enemy.
[Pending Patch] [Elune] Reduced the sound of Hell Scream by 60%.
[Elune] [Pending Update] Updated the tooltip of Waxing Moon to reflect that all offensive non-instant cast spells generate 1 stack of Waxing Moon on the struck target.
[Elune] [Pending Update] Fixed a bug affecting the Waxing Moon talent, causing some channeled abilities to be unable to generate Waxing Moon stacks.
[Elune] [Pending Update] Fixed a bug preventing Locust Cascade from triggering with the casters Plague Swarm active on the target.

[Elune] [Pending Update] Renamed the Harbinger of Flames proc, it is now called Fire Burst instead of Flame Burst, this was changed to prevent it from being mixed up with the Flameburst ability. The tooltip has been updated to properly communicate that it can only trigger from the direct hit of Fire Burst.
[Elune] [Pending Update] Fixed a bug causing the visual and animation of Hurricane Strike to not display while wielding a single two-handed weapon.
[Elune] [Pending Update] Fixed a bug which could prevent Wind Strike from benefitting from the energy cost reduction of Infused Energy.

[Elune] [Pending Update] Victorious Stand has been updated; all Victory Rush hits will now reduce the cooldown of Last Stand by 5 seconds. Using Last Stand now enables one use of Victory Rush, which further reduces the cooldown of Last Stand by an additional 35 seconds. This allows it to function identically for players using it prior to these changes while also making additional Victory Rush uses beneficial.
[Elune] [Pending Restart] Fixed a bug causing Fracture to stack with other attack power reductions.
[Elune] [Pending Restart] Fixed a bug preventing Hateful Strike from triggering the Spell Shredder talent.
[Elune] Fixed a bug where Devouring Plague was not able to critically hit.
[Elune] Fixed a bug where Dragon Charge did not always stop charging versus stun immune targets.
[Pending Restart] [Elune] Fixed a bug where Heroic Fury didn't reset the cooldown of Dragon Charge.
[Pending Restart] [Elune] Fixed an issue where Cryotherapy didn't work with Water Bolt.
Banshee's Wail now has a 2 minute cooldown, changed from 3.

0.description: Added new setting to prevent tab targeting to select a target that is not within line of sight to you. You can enable it by using /console tabTargetIgnoreNotLOS 1

[Elune] [Pending Restart] The 6 set bonus for dungeon tanking sets now has a 30 yard range and abides by line of sight rules. This affects the following tanking sets:  Cadaverous, Deathbone, Bravery and Courage.
The Kindred Spirits talent has been buffed to also increase the healing of your pet in addition to its damage and movement speed.
Queen Erethina will now properly continue her event when she appears during the quest "Reversion".
The Forgotten Avatar will now properly recognize when a player is nearby.

1.description: [Pending Restart] [Elune] Applied a fix that should fix most of the procs that were still bugged (for example Purifying Light) and were not triggering from spells with triggered spells like Mutilate, Mind Flay and Penance.
[Elune] [Pending Restart] Fixed an issue where Penance could not trigger the Blessing of the Divines effects.
[Elune] [Pending Restart] The mana cost of Downpour has been reduced by 40%.
[Elune] [Pending Update] Fixed an issue where Light of Life would only trigger on the caster. It will now trigger on all allies healed by Halo or Circle of Life.
[Pending Restart] [Elune] Fixed an issue where Righteous Zealot would not trigger from spells with triggered damage spells (for example Penance, Mind Flay and Mutilate.
[Pending Restart] [Elune] Fixed an issue where Amal'thazad's Malediction would not trigger from spells with triggered damage spells (for example Penance, Mind Flay and Mutilate.
Fixed an issue where Nature's Swiftness would not be consumed when using Thunderstorm together with Cloudburst (which gives it a cast time).

7.description: [Area-52] [Pending Restart] Fixed an issue where Divine Intervention stated it required primary stat spirit. It no longer has a primary stat allocation requirement.
[Area-52] [Pending Restart] Fixed an issue where Crusader's Promise and Crusader's Justice would be unlearned upon logging out and would require the ranks to be re-learnt.

1.description: [Elune] [Pending Update] Fixed a bug that reduced all life leeched by Drain Life if you knew Blood Arrow.
[Elune] [Pending Update] Fixed an issue where the Nature's Reach Capstone did not proliferate Shadow Swarm and Plague Swarm.
[Pending Restart] [Elune] Fixed an issue where the heal from Eternity was not being shown in the combat log.

0.description: Whitemane will no longer revive all of the adds in the Cathedral during a Manastorm.
Fixed an issue where the duration Rank 1 of Regrowth was scaling with haste.
Fixed a bug where Mending Tide was healing the caster for double the intended healing.
Fixed a bug where Mega Spellbind Roulette was giving first completion rewards for repeat completions.

1.description: [Pending Restart] [Elune] You will now be able to start casting your mount spell without first having to cancel your Dark Apotheosis buff. (You still can't ride the mount while it's active.)
[Pending Restart] [Elune] Fixed an issue where Dragon Charge shared a full cooldown with other gap closers, instead of 8 seconds.
[Elune] Fixed an issue where Downpour, Hammerstorm and Venom Belch did not have a global cooldown.
Fixed an issue where Charged Tides required Spirit Main stat. It will now work in all main stats.
The Static Shock capstone now properly adds charges to Thunder Hide and refreshes the duration in Wildcard.

[Elune] [Pending Update] Abilities made into combo-point generators through talents will now be able to trigger Focused Hunt, Sinister Transfusion, and Pack Tactics. The affected talents include Compound Power, Mark of the Beast, Rising Wrath, Savage Synergy, Violent Combo, and Judge, Jury, Executioner.
[Elune] Fixed a bug where Starborn did not grant Combusting Shots upon ending with the talent learnt.

0.description: Fixed a bug where Prayer of Preservation had Burning Crusade and WOTLK ranks available at level 60.
